Class ActivationPolicy.Builder

java.lang.Object
com.macstab.chaos.jvm.api.ActivationPolicy.Builder
Enclosing class:
ActivationPolicy
public static final class ActivationPolicy.Builder extends Object
Builder for ActivationPolicy. Unlike the canonical constructor it does not break when the record gains a field, so it is the recommended way to construct a policy in code.
